title: Exercise 1: Distribute and Combine
exerciseInfo: Practice distributing multiplication across sums and then combining like terms and constants to simplify a linear expression.
Arithmetic Level 2 is allowed. This permits nested sums and products, the negative unit, and simple nonnegative whole-number exponents.
Distribute each outside factor before combining the two x-terms and the numerical constants.
completionMessage: The expression is fully simplified: the like terms and constants have been combined.
